beats.title: Crafting is relocated and begins with alchemy and runic wood carving
beats.summary: The recap opens with the crafting sessions moved from the town square because of a large hole. The group starts moving through booths, beginning with goblin alchemy where Bonogo learns a basic poison lesson but crafts an autonomous green cleaning goo instead. Ephanna, Karsemine, and Caelynn then take on runic wood carving, where Ephanna excels and earns a Warding Rune while Caelynn does well and Karsemine struggles.

beats.title: Fey candy, teas, and forge crafting produce mixed results
beats.summary: The next booths focus on whimsy and utility. At a Fey-themed candy tent, Karsemine makes everlasting taffy for Torbin, Caelynn creates sour flavors, Ephanna performs well, and Bonogo accidentally creates a tiny fur monster before stealing a lollipop and sensing someone behind him. The group then visits a tea booth where Caelynn impresses the old lady enough to learn Stormbark Tea. Finally, they hit a forge booth where Baergrom excels at metalworking, is asked to help with a job, and spends the rest of the time making copper medallions.

beats.title: Druidic, illusion, jewelry, and storm booths deepen the group's crafting rewards and lore
beats.summary: The crafting tour continues with booths that recognize the group and branch into more specialized creations. In Druidic Carving, the group is thanked for helping end the abomination in Hempholm while attempting dryad charms. Next, at Illusion Painting, Ephanna earns praise for an exact copy of a Council member. Jewelry crafting with Knobs produces a tooth windchime, a danger-jingling charm, and a bone ring that whispers compliments. The final storm magic booth gives Caelynn lore about a vanished human professor once affiliated with the academy, who last was seen at Bald Green Hill and was described as highly nomadic.

beats.title: The finale pits the team against multiple elementals in a shifting arena
beats.summary: Crafting gives way to the Coliseum finale, where three teams remain and success depends on both victory and crowd approval. Bonogo, Ogonob, and Baergrom take the center as Lightning, Stone, and a bizarre glass-of-ale elemental appear. The fight swings through splash damage, crowd cheering, teleportation, blindness, commander tactics, and a conjured stone wall that separates Baergrom from allies before the stone elemental lands a heavy blow.
